mechanism: Amiodarone inhibits CYP2C9 and enhances the anticoagulant effects of warfarin (which is potentiated by vitamin K antagonism), increasing bleeding risk through reduced vitamin K-dependent clotting factor synthesis.
action: Monitor INR closely when initiating or adjusting amiodarone in patients on warfarin; vitamin K supplementation may be needed but should be coordinated with anticoagulation management to maintain therapeutic INR.
